summary: Engine terrain format as proven by MMR-16, read by the terrain compiler instead of hard-coding it. Every value is an output of the accepted MMR-16 runs and of the encoder they exercised (src/WorldBridge/surface.cpp). No new engine calibration was made for these values.

terrain.nodeSizeRule: nodeSize = extent / 4, representable at 0.001 world units (XML precision)
terrain.rasterOrientation: row-major heightfield, row r at y = r * extent / (side - 1), column c at x = c * extent / (side - 1)

height.byteOrder: big-endian (PNG network order inside terrain.bin HGHT)
height.range: hmin = floor(min * 1000) / 1000, hmax = ceil(max * 1000) / 1000 over the whole grid (one global range)
height.zeroRange: when hmax <= hmin, hmax = hmin + 1 (every sample quantizes to 0 and reconstructs exactly)
height.reconstruct: h' = hmin + q * (hmax - hmin) / 65535; |h - h'| <= (hmax - hmin) / 65535 / 2
height.engineVertex: the engine truncates vertex heights toward zero at 0.03 world units (MMR-16 collision model)

materials.layers: the template's material layers are terrain-materials.json layerSet in slot order; weights.bin v2 (MNBLWT02) names them, and the encoder refuses a template whose layers differ (surface.cpp check_template, MMR-255)
materials.base: slot 0 is written at full weight everywhere; every other slot holds the over-compositing alpha of its target fraction (MMR-249: alpha-over from slot 15 down)
materials.physics: PHYM per node, x-major: the dominant visible layer's slot, identical for all four seasons
materials.seasons: per-season masks and layer variants never switch at run time (MMR-249), so every season carries the same mask and the same layer

navigation.encoderNavmesh: 33 x 33 vertices, 2048 faces, z offset 0.2; slope > 1 -> group 7 else group 1 (surface encoder diagnostic navmesh only; campaign navmesh is MMR-28/38)

evidence.fields: accepted MMR-16 summary: encoded seeds 42/43 rendered, height, ground and ray queries
accepted run: 129-vertex surfaces at extents 256, 800 and 640 registered and rendered at runtime
11,956 offline assertions on the encoder's heights, normals, weights, physics and navigation
node layout, column = +X, row = +Y, shared borders, 16-bit heights
check_template (4x4 nodes, grass then rock_k), make_grid (129, 257 or 513, range, round-half-even), terrain (big-endian heights, slot 0 full, slot 1 weights, PHYM x-major), surface_main (extent rule)
MMR-249: a level-7 terrain (4 x 4 nodes of 128 cells, 513 samples) read in 0.13 s, ready in 0.9 s, rendered cleanly at the main-thread cost of level 6 (decision terrain513 go)

observedSides: MMR-16 ran 129-vertex surfaces in the engine. 257 is accepted by the same encoder path (level 6) and was used by the MMR-63 periodic fixture (257 x 257, 1600 extent, run 12348); both are proven. 513 (level 7, 128 cells per node) was proven by MMR-249's probe (map epic 2) and is the shaped surface side (MMR-278).
